title: Erasmus+ and Horizon Europe
grammar: Duties and Needs: köteles, kell, elengedhetetlen
goal: I can describe the December 2022 decision on Erasmus+ and Horizon Europe and its background (*Erasmus-program, Horizont Európa, összeférhetetlenségi szabály*).
I can report a demand about academic freedom with *kötelessége* and *kell*, naming whose demand it is.
I can say what the Council decided and what the Hungarian side said about it.
